name: mirage
text: Understood: over half failing, newly, and the same bets back in the list soon after. I'm not guessing at a cause. Your phone's next saved report is due in a few minutes, and the first one after your tries will have a NOFILL line for each miss with the price, its age and the depth. I'll read it as soon as it lands and tell you what it shows. Two things I'll compare against it: whether the misses cluster on the engine's list rows or on rows your phone re-priced itself, and whether they began with the v1.0.73-1.0.77 list changes. I'll revert that change if it caused this.
